titulo: Cop31 live: world leaders gather for crucial climate crisis talks
cuerpo: UN climate summit will focus on how to implement the targets needed to urgently cut greenhouse gas emissions What is at stake at the UN climate summit and what can it achieve? Key players at the climate talks Next up is the Australian climate change minister, Chris Bowen , who is president of the negotiations here in Antalya. This is his big moment to set the tone for the next two weeks, and he said even though the 1.5C Paris target will be overshot, “we can return … if we work together and act with urgency, solidarity and resolve.” Continue reading...
